packet.title: XPath and XQuery conformance sweep (implementation)
packet.summary: Fixes XPath and XQuery leftovers: Q{}N name tests on JNodes, modules found without location hints, run-time type constructors and several option and collation cases.

body.p: After . From fresh whole runs (XP40 36 failed and 30 wrong-error passes, XQ40 107 and 44), with 's open list: Q{}N name tests on JNodes (sxml_name_test frozen), named item type constructors and function items made by fn:function-lookup at run time, eqname-007, two modules of one namespace without a location hint, serialization singletons; a review of the not-run categories (static typing excluded, ). Verification as says. Done 2026-10-20 (): JNode Q{}N and p:N tests, modules a resolver lists for an import without hints (additive contract), run-time type constructors, option conventions in deep-equal and collation, fn:slice limits, fn:op collations, XQST0134, adaptive INF/NaN, the driver's moduleImport and format-integer sequences; XP40 32,797 to 32,809 passed, XQ40 46,101 to 46,138, none lost. Open: 's "Not done" (xqhof18, eqname-007, modules-43).
